description: This file defines the DialogRenderer class, which handles rendering dialog responses in Drupal, including generating dialog content, setting dialog options, and managing dialog target elements.

classes.name: DialogRenderer
classes.description: Handles rendering dialog responses for main content in Drupal, including generating dialog content, options, and target selectors.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the title resolver and renderer dependencies.

methods.name: renderResponse
methods.description: Generates an Ajax response for rendering main content within a dialog, attaching necessary libraries, and setting up the dialog command.

methods.name: determineTargetSelector
methods.description: Determines the target selector for the dialog, either from options or based on the route name.

methods.name: getDialogOptions
methods.description: Retrieves dialog options from the HTTP request, depending on the request method.

methods.name: getTitleAsStringable
methods.description: Gets the dialog title as a string or stringable object, either from main content or route information.
